title: Wait Until Something Is Ready (poll with timeout)
description: Waits until a TCP port is open, a file exists, a systemd service is active, or a process is running, then continues. Uses Ansible's native wait_for module for the port/file cases -- register+until+retries for service/process, since wait_for itself doesn't check those directly.

variables.name: HOST
variables.prompt: Host to check (only used for the port check)

variables.name: PORT
variables.prompt: Port number (only used for the port check)

variables.name: FILE_PATH
variables.prompt: File path (only used for the file check)

variables.name: SERVICE_NAME
variables.prompt: systemd service name (only used for the service check)

variables.name: PROCESS_NAME
variables.prompt: Process name to look for, as pgrep would match it (only used for the process check)

variables.name: WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.prompt: Give up after this many seconds (only used for the port/file checks)

variables.name: RETRIES
variables.prompt: Number of checks before giving up (only used for the service/process checks)

variables.name: POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
variables.prompt: Seconds between checks (only used for the service/process checks)
